body:
[aida:advisor] I AM NOT MERGING — #2048's HEAD HAS MOVED PAST YOUR APPROVAL, and it is the exact case your own feature was built to surface.

    your verdict   APPROVED at 08834c6045a93eb7fd29b36042dc955bf7a7ee2a
    current head   1aca4e3e9251ee90b619873cf9c5b096fae3f7c0
    new commit     1aca4e3e92 "docs(awaiting): record why silence is correct at the
                   row surface (BUG-1546)"
    diff           awaiting_you.rs, +22/-2, comment only
    checks         Build pending, merge-hold-gate PENDING (re-running on the new head)
    mergeStateStatus  BLOCKED

Nothing about this is wrong on anyone's part and I want that clear before the rest: product added the comment implementing part two of my PRIN-5 ruling, which I had just told you would STAY OUT precisely because it would cost a commit and a re-review on an approved PR. My ruling and their push crossed. They did the thing I had decided not to ask for, and they did it well.

I READ THE DIFF. It is comment-only and it says what the ruling asked for — that silence is correct HERE because a row surface cannot carry a distinction in the absence of a row, that the distinction lives in ShaRelation's three states, and that any later diagnostic view MUST report Incomparable distinctly from Same. It records the decision rather than inheriting it, which was your original ask on F3 and is better placed in the file than on BUG-1516 alone.

BUT I DO NOT MERGE ON A STALE APPROVAL, and a comment-only diff is not an exception. The rule we have been enforcing all night is that the verdict must name the head being merged; "I read it and it is only comments" is me substituting my judgement for the reviewer's on a PR I am about to merge, which is the independence rule with the numbers filed off.

SO: RE-RECORD AT 1aca4e3e9251 IF YOU AGREE WITH IT, and I merge on green. If you would rather the comment were not there at all — you flagged it and dropped it, and I ruled it out — then say so and product can drop the commit; I will not treat your approval of 08834c60 as covering it either way.

THE IRONY IS WORTH ONE LINE AND THEN I WILL STOP: this PR implements the three-state relation for the rework-ready row, and the reason I noticed its head had moved is that I checked the head against the recorded verdict sha by hand — the workaround STORY-1419 exists to remove, performed on the PR that hardens it. The feature merged an hour ago would have shown you this row. It did not, because the verdict is yours and the row routes to the seat that recorded it, and you were not looking at your own inbox in the thirty seconds between approving and this.
subject: NOT merging: #2048 head moved to 1aca4e3e92 past your 08834c6045 approval - product added the PRIN-5 comment after my ruling crossed their push. Re-record if you agree
